rationale: No analog interface; pure digital serial protocol

signaling_summary: DVI / HDMI T.M.D.S. (Transition-Minimized Differential Signaling) is a current-mode differential serial interface DC-coupled between the TFP410 transmitter and the display receiver. Each of the 4 differential output pairs (TX0/TX1/TX2/TXC) is driven by a current-mode driver whose full-scale current I_FS is set by R_TFADJ; receiver provides 50 Ω termination to AV_DD; V_SWING ≈ 400-600 mV single-ended. Input side (DATA/IDCK/DE/HSYNC/VSYNC/CTL) supports HIGH-SWING (3.3 V CMOS) when V_REF=DV_DD, and LOW-SWING (1.1-1.8 V) when V_REF=0.55-0.9 V. PLL multiplies IDCK by 10× internally to generate the serializer bit clock. On-chip 1.8 V regulators + bypass capacitors isolate PLL from supply noise.
ic_name: HDMI / DVI TMDS (TI TFP410 PanelBus Digital Transmitter — subset)

tmds_data_rate_ranges.raw_pixel_throughput_per_pair_pixels_per: pixel_clock × 1 (3 pixels per IDCK period total across TX0/TX1/TX2)

termination_and_swing_setup.TFADJ_purpose: External pull-up resistor on TFADJ pin (to TV_DD) sets V_SWING ≈ 400-600 mV.
termination_and_swing_setup.tmds_OFF_state: When TMDS disabled (PD=0 or TDIS=1), V_OFF = AV_DD on both legs.

analog_components_per_channel: Current-mode differential driver (programmable full-scale current via TFADJ).
10:1 serializer clocked by the 10× PLL bit clock.
Receiver-side: 100 Ω differential termination (50 Ω each leg to AV_DD), comparator, 1:10 deserializer, 10b → 8b decoder.
shared_analog_blocks: PLL (PV_DD supply; on-chip 1.8 V regulators + bypass caps).
Input voltage-mode receivers (3.3 V CMOS or low-swing comparator).
Input clock receiver (single-ended or differential per VREF + DSEL).
notes: TFP410 is a mixed-signal device with a high-speed analog TMDS PHY on the output side and CMOS digital interface on the input side. PLL is the dominant analog risk; TI provides on-chip 1.8 V regulators + bypass capacitors to suppress jitter (t_ojit ≤ 150 ps). PCB layout follows standard high-speed differential rules (100 Ω diff, ≤ 50 ps intra-pair skew, ≤ 1.2 ns channel-to-channel skew, ESD ±4 kV HBM on DVI pins).
